title: Sender-constrained candidate channel credential — C2 profile (DESIGN.md §14.3, §7.4, §16.6 item 12; byom amendment A4; family contract R11)
description: The candidate-side sender-constrained channel §16.6 item 12 requires, profiled per §14.3's normative sentence — a candidate credential is sender-constrained and contains ONLY the exact offer, candidate Participant id, proposed Manifestation digest, onboarding fence, candidate actor/control-domain evidence, and allowed candidate operations — and amendment A4's candidate binding lifecycle: minted with the offer; closed server-side on admission, refusal, revocation, or expiry; it never converts in place — the participant channel is a new credential minted at admission. §16 carries no field list (recorded gap — same derived-not-verbatim honesty as the slice-1 DPC; the §14.3-vs-§14.4 citation note applies here too). It is not Standing; elicitation through the binding is never assent; successful admission, refusal, revocation, or expiry atomically fences it (§14.3).

nonce.description: Single-use: the (issuer_ref, nonce) pair is atomic (UNIQUE enforced in code).

method.description: Closed §14.3 list: mTLS or DPoP-style proof key, or a local channel-exporter binding.

sender_constraint.description: Sender-constrained, not merely bearer and audience-bound (§14.3).

membership_offer_ref.description: Exactly one MembershipOffer (amendment A4); a terminal offer fences this credential while an exact refusal retry still returns its retained receipt.

proposed_manifestation_digest.description: §14.3 verbatim member: the proposed Manifestation digest.

control_domain_binding_ref.description: Candidate control-domain evidence (§14.3; CandidateSelfPolicyProposal.adoption_control_domain_ref pins the same domain).

onboarding_fence_epoch.description: Refusal, offer revocation, or expiry atomically fences this credential without creating Standing (§14.3/§7.4).

surface.description: The candidate surface only (R11); no human-authority, governance, or admin tool exists on this binding (amendment A4).

allowed_operations.description: §7.4 OnboardingActivationOffer.allowed_operations verbatim (= the R11 candidate operation set; C3a candidate MCP profile binds exactly these).

identifier.description: Opaque visible-ASCII identifier, at most 128 bytes (§14.9).

safeNonNegativeInteger.description: I-JSON safe integer (§14.2 rejects unsafe integers).

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 UTC instant with Z offset. DESIGN.md does not fix a timestamp wire encoding; this derivation freezes with the bundle (gap note G3).

digestRef.$comment: The closed family DigestRef wire (family-vectors/PROFILE.md §6.1, normative; D-R0-1): exactly the members {class, algorithm, key_ref?, value_hex}. The oneOf pins the closed class/algorithm pairing and requires key_ref exactly for the keyed erasure classes; each arm refines members of this already-closed object.

class.description: Digest class (PROFILE.md §6, D-R0-1); substituting one class where a schema requires another is a conformance failure.

key_ref.description: Key id for the keyed erasure classes; raw HMAC keys, per-object secrets, and salts are never part of a DigestRef.

digestRef.description: Typed DigestRef: every digest field is typed, never an unlabelled hash. Wire shape, class/algorithm pairing, and key_ref presence per the ratified family profile.
